notes.title: 1.0.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes: To improve ease of use the default language of the game will now be set according to the system language when starting the game.

notes.title: 1.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
1.0.3 Patch notes

Adjustments to scenario text 　

Small adjustments to scenario text to fix translation errors. 



Fixing error of HP bar UI

During certain conditions the UI of the HP bar was not displayed correctly.

This has been corrected.



Fixing error in the skill tree 　

Increases to the HP of the character which can be achieved  
through acquiring passive skills  in the skill tree were not reflected correctly.

This has been corrected.



Other small adjustments.
